question.text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))
question.resolution_criteria:
This question will resolve as the midpoint of the guidance range for Q4 FY2027 as stated in NVIDIA’s “Outlook” section of its Q3 FY2027 earnings press release, expected to be published on [NVIDIA’s investor relations site](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/) and the [SEC’s EDGAR system](https://www.sec.gov/) on November 17, 2026.

The unit value for revenues is billions of U.S. dollars, and it will be rounded to the nearest billion. GAAP gross margin will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a percent. GAAP operating expenses are in a unit value of billions of U.S. dollars and will be rounded to the nearest tenth of a billion dollars.
question.fine_print:
* If a single figure (not a range) is provided, that figure will be used.
* If multiple ranges or scenarios are presented, the primary range specified in the official “Outlook” or “Guidance” section will be used to resolve the subquestions.
* If NVIDIA does not issue guidance for Q4 FY2027 in the Q3 FY2027 release, the corresponding subquestion will be **annulled**.
* Only the originally published figure will be used; subsequent updates, corrections, or guidance revisions will be ignored.

# NVIDIA Q4 FY2027 GAAP opex guidance: research brief

Main takeaways:
- **Implied Q4:** Management's latest full-year view (opex growth "in the low 50s" percent, said August 26, 2026) points to Q4 GAAP opex of roughly $9.4 to 10.1 billion. That is my own calculation, shown under heading 4.
- **Past pattern:** Applying the past Q3-to-Q4 guidance steps (+7% to +14%) to $9.2 billion gives roughly $9.8 to 10.5 billion. The step percentages for the earlier years are from my memory and I did not check them.
- **Huang's exit:** I found no reported accounting charge from it.

## 1. Resolution source
- The deciding figure will be the Outlook section of the Q3 FY2027 press release on nvidianews.nvidia.com and EDGAR. It is due November 17, 2026 after the market closes. Not yet published as of 2026-11-14.
- 2026-08-26: The latest Outlook (for Q3 FY27) said: "GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $9.2 billion and $9.0 billion, respectively." NVIDIA gives opex as a single "approximately" figure, not a range, so the fine print's single-figure rule would likely apply. [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing settles the question yet.
- Kalshi gives a 4% chance that the earnings call is postponed (before Nov 18).

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-13: Bloomberg, via Business Standard, reports that Huang forfeits about $108M in unvested stock awards. The 8-K reportedly describes no severance deal. I found no report of a related charge. Forfeiture normally reverses expense already booked rather than adding a new charge, but I could not confirm how NVIDIA will book it. [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/amp/world-news/jensen-huang-to-forfeit-108-million-in-unvested-nvidia-stock-awards-126111300257_1.html), [Stocktitan](https://www.stocktitan.net/articles/jensen-huang-resigns-nvidia-ceo-2026)
- 2026-11-13: Previews say CFO Colette Kress, now interim CEO, will present the report. The shares closed at $166.19, more than 30% below the October 6 close. [Invezz](https://invezz.com/nl/nieuws/2026/11/13/nvidia-kwartaalcijfers-wat-te-verwachten-nu-kress-eerste-test-zonder-huang-krijgt/), [Zacks](https://www.zacks.com/stock/news/3029813/boardroom-drama-ahead-of-nvidia-s-q3-earnings-buy-or-sell-the-stock)
- 2026-11-11: The board accepted Huang's resignation, effective immediately. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvda-20261111.htm)
- 2026-08-26: On the Q2 call, Kress said: "For the full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low 50s driven by a broadening of our product portfolio," plus wider use of AI tools. In May she had said "upper-40s." [Webull transcript](https://www.webull.com/news/15497781742806016), [Q1 call via Fool](https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-q1-2027-earnings-transcript/)
- 2026-08-26: Q2 opex rose 10% from the prior quarter on a GAAP basis, driven by compute infrastructure and pay. [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/transcript-nvidia-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-26/)
- Since Q1 FY27, non-GAAP figures include stock-based compensation, so GAAP and non-GAAP now differ by only about $0.2B. [NVIDIA Q1 FY27](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027)

## 4. Base rates
**GAAP opex guidance compared with actuals**

| Quarter | Guide ($B) | Actual ($B) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Q4 FY26 | ~6.7 | 6.794 (above guide) | [NVIDIA](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-Fourth-Quarter-and-Fiscal-2026) |
| Q1 FY27 | ~7.7 (incl. $1.9B SBC) | 7.621 | [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027) |
| Q2 FY27 | ~8.5 | 8.408 | [NVIDIA](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027) |
| Q3 FY27 | ~9.2 | due Nov 17 | same |

- The guide has risen each quarter: 6.7, 7.7, 8.5, 9.2. That is +1.0, +0.8 and +0.7, or about +15%, +10% and +8%.

**Q3-to-Q4 guide step in past years (seasonality)**
- FY26: Q3 guide $5.9B to Q4 guide $6.7B, +14%. I recall the $6.7B figure but did not re-check it.
- FY25: about $4.3B to $4.8B, +12%. From memory, not checked.
- FY24: about $2.95B to $3.17B, +7%. From memory, not checked.
- Applied to $9.2B, these steps give roughly $9.8 to 10.5B.

**Implied Q4 from the "low 50s" full-year growth (my calculation)**
- FY26 GAAP opex: about $5.03 + 5.41 + 5.84 + 6.79 = $23.1B. The Q2 FY26 figure ($5.41B) is from memory.
- Growth of 50 to 53% gives a full-year FY27 total of about $34.6 to 35.3B.
- FY27 so far: $7.62 + 8.41 + 9.2 (Q3 guide) = $25.2B.
- That leaves an implied Q4 of about **$9.4 to 10.1B**. A Q3 actual below $9.2B would push the implied Q4 slightly higher.
- I am not sure whether "low 50s" is measured on a GAAP or non-GAAP basis, but the result is similar either way.
- Upside risk: the full-year opex outlook was raised once already (upper 40s to low 50s). The question's range is 9.45 to 11.25.

- Consensus for Q3 revenue is about $108.8B. [Crypto Briefing](https://cryptobriefing.com/nvidia-q3-fy2027-preview-279-billion-supply/)

## 6. Upcoming events
- 2026-11-17, after the market closes: Q3 FY27 release and CFO commentary, which settle the question. Things to watch:
  - The Q3 actual compared with the $9.2B guide.
  - Any update to the full-year opex growth figure.
  - Any accounting from the leadership change or legal/governance costs, which could hit GAAP opex.
  - Whether the CEO transition makes management more cautious about guidance.
- No weather dependence.

### 1. Resolution source
- 2026-08-26: The resolving line from last quarter's (Q2 FY2027) Outlook section reads: "GAAP and non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $9.2 billion and $9.0 billion, respectively". That was for Q3. Actual GAAP opex was $8,408M in Q2 and $7,621M in Q1. Stock-based compensation was $2,027M in Q2. - My own judgment, not reported anywhere: if Huang's unvested equity is forfeited, previously booked stock-based compensation could be reversed, and legal or investigation costs could add expense. Both are probably small next to about $10B, but either could move a figure that is rounded to $0.1B.

- **Seasonality:** Q4 guides have recently been large steps: +14% for Q4 FY26 and about +12% for Q4 FY25. My extrapolation: if Q3 actual is about $9.1-9.2B, a 9-14% step implies roughly $9.9-10.5B.

(b) The latest value from the resolution source is the Q3 FY27 GAAP opex guide: approximately $9.2B, issued August 26, 2026. Earlier guides were 6.7, 7.7 and 8.5. Actuals have landed about $0.1B under each guide.

(c) If nothing changed, the guide would stay flat at $9.2B. That is unlikely, because NVIDIA's opex guide has risen every quarter.

(d) If the trend continued, the next step would be about +$0.6 to 0.8B, following the +1.0, +0.8 and +0.7 pattern. That gives roughly $9.8 to 10.0B. A separate check uses the full-year "low 50s" growth comment:
* FY26 GAAP opex was about $23.1B.
* FY27 so far is about $25.1B, assuming a Q3 actual near $9.1B.
* That implies a Q4 of about $9.5B (50% growth) to $10.2B (53% growth).
* The midpoint is about $9.8 to 9.9B.
* The full-year outlook was raised once already, which tilts slightly upward.

(e) Historical variation: past Q3-to-Q4 guide steps were +7% to +14%. Applied to $9.2B, that gives $9.8 to 10.5B. The quarter-to-quarter step in the guide has varied by about ±$0.3B.

(f) I found no consensus or market on Q4 opex guidance. The question creator expects a range of 9.5 to 11.2. The full-year commentary centers near $9.9B.

(g) Unexpected scenarios:
* **Low:** After the CEO change and a 30% share price drop, interim management turns cautious and trims hiring or compute spend. Combined with stock-award forfeiture effects, that could put the guide near $9.3 to 9.5B.
* **High:** Retention grants for the executive team after Huang's exit, legal or governance costs, or a further raise of the full-year growth figure to the mid-to-upper 50s could push the guide to $10.6 to 11B.
